scope: existing final release Native Verified ProjectFileContent shell; complex cohort x5 per format; not full App startup or CPU profiling

metadata.qualification: serial native ProjectFileContent, visible incognito WebView; OS caches retained; excludes full application startup

interpretation.statistics: Milliseconds, elapsed wall time; rawms follow refs order; p95 is nearest rank ceil(.95*n). null is unavailable, never zero or pass.
interpretation.clocks: Host commands, scenario boundaries and document 0 marks share one run clock. Each iframe snapshot is kept local: URL/index do not establish lifecycle identity. performance.timeOrigin is absent; do not align iframe, host, Rust or runner times.
interpretation.capture: All recorded document marks/resources are retained, including repeated marks and final snapshots. Native harness captured only office-component/office-xlsx marks, last 100 per document. Missing marks do not prove absent work. Span endpoints require unique marks; adjacent gaps are elapsed intervals, not attribution.
interpretation.file: project_file_resolve, file_versions_list, project_file_read_bytes and file_source_read are real command envelope durations, including bridge/native/serialization. commandOffset/count identifies scenario. first_other_file AND close_reopen open simple fixtures even in the complex cohort; file identity is retained.
interpretation.module: requested->ready is lazy component module load/evaluation elapsed, potentially network/cache and shared imports. mounted is React wrapper commit, not renderer ready. wrapper_commit_to_scenario_ready bundles renderer import, initialize, font, parse, layout, paint and readiness waits.
interpretation.font: XLSX font_guard is the existing Promise.race registration/loading/timeout guard, not isolated font fetch/decode CPU. main_import completion is module evaluation completion; asynchronous bootstrap continues. main_font_overlap must not be added twice.
interpretation.renderer: entry_to_ready contains other spans; calculation_start_to_applied includes session/queue/application waits. Rendered/Steady and rendered-hooks-complete are lifecycle signals, not isolated layout or paint timing. Only cold iframe spans are aggregated; later snapshots may repeat the same iframe lifetime.
interpretation.outer: Rust inspect origin: read includes File validation/lookup/version/content read/base64; workerAwait contains the worker plus surrounding await; revalidation repeats File validation/read after await. These are sequential within outer, total is not an extra phase.
interpretation.worker: Separate Rust worker-entry origin: preparationAndSlot includes frame serialization/admission; temporarySetupAndSpawn includes temp setup/OS spawn/process attachment; sendReceiveAndExecution includes parallel send/receive, Node boot/import, engine inspect and response; exitWaitAndDecode includes process wait/JSON decode. total is not an extra phase.
interpretation.overlap: Host segment active IDs show observed module/command concurrency. Native worker work is nested in outer workerAwait, not additive. Worker pipe send/receive run concurrently. No exact JS-command/native-request join exists: JS commands lack requestId; workers are grouped only by run/format and include both complex and simple inspections, never labeled cold by log order.
interpretation.status: Original scenario/run status is retained; observed timing is not an acceptance pass. No missing cost is estimated from a residual or assigned to CPU.

unavailable.cost: isolated engine inspect / Node module import / IPC send vs receive
unavailable.reason: Office worker has one combined response interval, no engine/internal Node spans; MD has no Office inspect worker (not applicable).
Recorded spawn segment includes temporary setup and process attachment.
No renderer-internal marks in captured reports; host component import is separate from iframe runtime loading.

unavailable.cost: font transfer / font decode / document parse / layout / paint separately
unavailable.reason: No matching isolated spans. ResourceTiming entries are retained but do not isolate decode/layout/paint; positive visual gates are evidence of readiness, not cost measurements.

unavailable.cost: full App startup / cross-clock critical path / CPU / heap
unavailable.reason: Document-shell reports, no timeOrigin alignment, CPU profiler or heap capture.
